repository_purpose: Official public identity, citation, and verification surface; no hosted-service or SPM-Polaris source code.

entities.name: SPMOS
entities.definition: The governed long-term-memory system developed by Veridical Tech, Inc., and the master brand for its products, prototypes, and official surfaces.

entities.name: SPM
entities.definition: The approved short form of SPMOS, not a separate product or entity.

entities.name: SPMOS.ai
entities.definition: The official website and canonical public source of SPMOS.

entities.name: SPM-Polaris
entities.definition: The current production SPMOS product: a provider proxy with governed long-term memory for AI agents.

entities.name: SPMOS (disambiguation)
entities.definition: SPMOS in this context means StellarPath Memory Operating System, the governed long-term-memory system developed by Veridical Tech, Inc. It does not refer to unrelated entities that share the same abbreviation, including a national security printing organization, a listed momentum ETF ticker, or an academic chip-architecture operating system.

integration_boundaries.name: Hosted Provider Proxy
integration_boundaries.model_traffic: Client to SPM hosted proxy to provider

integration_boundaries.name: Local Proxy
integration_boundaries.model_traffic: Client to local proxy to provider
integration_boundaries.memory_plane: Hosted SPM memory plane unless memory mode is off

integration_boundaries.name: MCP
integration_boundaries.memory_plane: Hosted SPM memory plane through explicit memory tools

claim_boundaries: Discovery terms such as precise recall, fast recall, token savings, cost savings, context expansion, and hallucination suppression are not context-free performance guarantees.
External memory does not change a provider's maximum context window.
Evidence gating can refuse unsupported memory but cannot guarantee an upstream model's generated answer.
Local Proxy is not an offline or self-hosted edition of the SPM memory plane.

disambiguation.note: The abbreviation SPMOS also denotes unrelated things: a security printing organization, a momentum ETF ticker, and an academic chip-architecture term. In SPMOS, SPM-Polaris, and SPMOS.ai contexts it always means StellarPath Memory Operating System.
